;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[August 2020 Afghanistan attacks]]
***[[Jalalabad prison attack]]
****The [[Afghan Armed Forces|military]] retake a prison in [[Jalalabad]], [[Nangarhar Province|Nangarhar]] that came under attack yesterday by [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]], resulting in a mass [[jailbreak]] and [[shootout]] between Afghan forces and [[jihadist]]s that ended today. At least 29 people are killed and 50 injured, among them civilians, prisoners, guards and Afghan security forces. [https://apnews.com/a6e54b22ba067b2d0fc89e9be4c27fb1 (AP)]
*[[Israeli–Syrian ceasefire line incidents during the Syrian Civil War]], [[Israeli involvement in the Syrian Civil War]]
**[[Israeli Air Force]] helicopters strike [[Syria]]n military observation posts, intelligence collection systems, anti-aircraft batteries and command-and-control bases in [[Quneitra Governorate]], in response to yesterday's incident along the [[Purple Line (ceasefire line)|Purple Line]] border fence in the [[Golan Heights]], in which four militants were killed after attempting to plant an [[Improvised explosive device|IED]] where Israeli soldiers patrol. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-syria-violence/israeli-aircraft-hit-syria-after-squad-tried-to-bomb-border-fence-military-says-idUSKBN24Y0RP?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Pope Benedict XVI|Pope Benedict]]'s official biographer, Peter Seewald, reports former pope is "very frail" since his return from visiting his older brother, Msgr. [[Georg Ratzinger]], in Bavaria. His personal secretary, Archbishop [[Georg Gänswein|George Ganswein]], states "the health conditions are not of particular concern, except for those of a 93 year old who is going through a painful, but not serious, disease." [https://www.ncregister.com/news/vatican-pope-benedict-xvi-health-not-serious-concern (CNA/EWTN News)]

;Business and economy
*[[Prime Minister of Italy|Italian Prime Minister]] [[Giuseppe Conte]] inaugurates the [[Genoa-Saint George Bridge|new replacement]] for the original [[Ponte Morandi]] bridge, two years after [[Ponte Morandi collapse|its collapse]], amidst the ongoing pandemic in the country. [[President of Italy|Italian President]] [[Sergio Mattarella]] and bridge architect [[Renzo Piano]] attend the ceremony. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/08/03/world/europe/genoa-italy-new-bridge.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.archpaper.com/2020/08/renzo-pianos-saint-george-bridge-inaugurated-in-genoa-italy/ (''The Architect's Newspaper'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Isaias]]  
***Isaias regains hurricane strength with maximum winds of [[Saffir–Simpson scale|75 mph (120 km/h)]] after leaving 2-4 inches of precipitation and  causing minor power outages along the [[Florida]] coast. The storm is moving north-northeast at 16 mph (26 km/h), and is expected to make landfall in eastern [[North Carolina]] early Tuesday and then continue along the [[Mid-Atlantic (United States)|Mid-Atlantic coast]] heading toward  the [[Northeastern United States|northeastern states]]. The [[storm surge]] will cause normally dry areas near the coast to be flooded with rising waters before moving inland.  [https://www.npr.org/2020/08/03/898620721/tropical-storm-isaias-expected-to-make-landfall-as-a-hurricane-in-carolinas (NPR)] [https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCPAT4+shtml/040000.shtml (National Hurricane Center)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[Premier of Victoria|Victorian premier]] [[Daniel Andrews]] orders the temporary closure of many businesses and retail stores in Melbourne under stage four lockdown restrictions for six weeks to contain the spread of COVID-19 in [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]]. Only essential services such as supermarkets, food stores, liquor shops, petrol stations, pharmacies, convenience stores, and other essentials can remain open. [https://www.9news.com.au/national/coronavirus-victoria-thousands-lose-work-as-mass-business-closures-ordered-construction-manufacturing-retail/a35c94c1-e978-44b1-ae39-3517db07ebb7 (9 News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
***[[BBC News]] reports that the number of deaths and confirmed cases of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] in [[Iran]] are about three times higher than what was reported by the [[government of Iran|government]], according to a data leak. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-53598965 (BBC News)] [https://www.businessinsider.com/iran-nearly-triple-officially-reported-covid-19-deaths-bbc-2020-8 (''Business Insider'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
***[[Catalonia]] exceeds 100,000 COVID-19 cases since the beginning of the pandemic. [https://www.lavanguardia.com/vida/20200803/482643593201/coronavirus-catalunya-supera-100000-casos-covid-19-cinco-meses-pandemia.html (''La Vanguardia'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]]'s [[Chief of Staff of the Presidency (Brazil)|Chief of Staff of the Presidency]] [[Walter Souza Braga Netto]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-brazil/chief-of-staff-to-brazils-bolsonaro-tests-positive-for-covid-19-idUSKCN24Z2TU?il=0 (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction]]
**A leaked [[UN Security Council Sanctions Committee on North Korea]] report says several states believe [[North Korea]] has "probably developed miniaturized nuclear devices to fit into the [[Nuclear-warhead|warheads]] of its ballistic missiles". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-sanctions-un/north-korea-has-probably-developed-nuclear-devices-to-fit-ballistic-missiles-says-u-n-report-idUSKCN24Z2PO?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Internet censorship in Thailand]]
**[[Thailand]]'s digital minister threatens action against [[Facebook]] for not complying with the [[government of Thailand|government]] request to restrict content that is illegal in the country, including [[Lèse majesté in Thailand|insults of]] [[King of Thailand|King]] [[Vajiralongkorn]]. Facebook responded by disabling [[English language|English]]-to-[[Thai language|Thai]] automatic translations. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-facebook/thai-minister-threatens-facebook-with-legal-action-over-restriction-requests-idUSKBN24Z1RA?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Monarchy of Spain]], [[Corruption in Spain]]
**The [[Royal Household of Spain|Spanish Royal Household]] announces that Emeritus [[King of Spain|King]] [[Juan Carlos I]] has informed King [[Felipe VI]] that he is leaving the country motivated by "the public repercussion that certain past events are generating". His finances are being judicially investigated by a Swiss judge and the Spanish Prosecutor's Office for alleged financial dealings from [[Haramain high-speed railway]] construction and his accounts in tax havens. [https://www.elmundo.es/espana/2020/08/03/5f26ec90fc6c832f068b45a3.html (''El Mundo'')] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/amid-a-financial-scandal-former-spanish-king-juan-carlos-i-says-he-is-leaving-spain-to-live-in-another-country/2020/08/03/0df33322-d5a6-11ea-a788-2ce86ce81129_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-53642283 (BBC News)]
*[[Killing of George Floyd]]
**Newly leaked bodycam footage shows [[George Floyd]] pleading with police officers not to lock him up in a police vehicle, as well as saying that he is claustrophobic. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/leaked-footage-shows-first-moments-george-floyd-s-fatal-arrest-n1235663 (NBC News)]
*Authorities announce the arrest of a 48-year-old man two days earlier in [[San Antonio]], [[Texas]], US, for threatening to commit a [[mass shootings in the United States|mass shooting]] at [[Fort Hood]] in retaliation for the [[killing of Vanessa Guillén]] there in April. He is being charged with making [[terroristic threat]]s. [https://www.expressnews.com/news/local/article/Man-arrested-in-connection-to-Facebook-post-15454946.php (''San Antonio Express-News'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 United States presidential election]]
**[[Postal voting in the United States]]
***[[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] vows to sue [[Nevada]] over legislation signed by [[List of governors of Nevada|Governor]] [[Steve Sisolak]] that, amid the COVID-19 pandemic, requires election officials to send all active, registered voters a mail-in ballot ahead of the November election. This also would apply to any others that happen in the wake of a statewide emergency or disaster directive. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-election-nevada/trump-threatens-to-sue-nevada-to-block-universal-mail-in-ballots-idUSKCN24Z2DV (Reuters)] [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/nevadalawmakers-mailing-voters-ballots-trump-slams-move-72146935 (AP via ABC News)] 
***Donald Trump says he has the right to issue an [[executive order]] on mail-in voting but has not done so yet. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-voting/trump-says-he-can-issue-order-on-mail-in-voting-but-hasnt-gotten-to-it-idUSKCN24Z2QO?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Government of Lebanon|Lebanese]] Foreign Minister [[Nassif Hitti]] resigns over the government's slow pace at reforms, warning the country is at risk of becoming a [[failed state]]. Diplomatic affairs advisor Charbel Wehbe takes his place. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/08/lebanon-foreign-minister-quits-pm-lack-reformist-200803081938960.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Science and technology
*Two anonymous sources confirm to [[Reuters]] that the classified [[United Kingdom]]–[[United States]] trade documents leaked ahead of the [[2019 United Kingdom general election|UK parliamentary election last year]] was caused by [[Russia]]n hacking of the email account of former UK [[Department for International Trade|International Trade Secretary]] [[Liam Fox]]. They declined to name which Russian group or organisation they believed was responsible, but said the attack bore the hallmarks of a [[Government of Russia|government]]-backed operation. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-britain-russia-hack-exclusive/exclusive-papers-leaked-before-uk-election-in-suspected-russian-operation-were-hacked-from-ex-trade-minister-sources-idUKKBN24Z1UL (Reuters)]
